samples.question: The image has a REFERENCE panel and candidates A and B. Each panel contains six uniquely colored disks and one vertical divider. A disk is on the LEFT or RIGHT side according to which side of the divider its center occupies. Which candidate has exactly the same color-to-side assignment as the REFERENCE? A is the middle panel and B is the right panel. Ignore panel location, divider position, disk size, and line thickness. Answer A or B.
